description:
Title: Becoming A Parent

Create a process that support in planning, taking and extending a maternity leave.  
* Fetch information about potential models (months duration, split between parents) 
* Let parent select 
* Collect relevant information 
* Notify Social Security, Company in time 
* Gather information from companies 
* At the end of the period let parent decide about extension.
generated_bpmn_xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_BecomingAParent"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/becoming-a-parent">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_MaternityLeave" name="Becoming A Parent" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Planning" name="Leave planning started">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_1</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_FetchModels" name="Fetch leave models">
      <bpmn:documentation>Fetch information about potential leave models (duration in months, split between parents).</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ExtensionYes</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SelectModel" name="Select leave model">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_3</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CollectInfo" name="Collect relevant information">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_3</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_4</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_Notify_Split" name="Notify parties">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_4</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_5</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_6</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_NotifySocialSecurity" name="Notify Social Security in time">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_5</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_7</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_NotifyCompany" name="Notify company in time">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_6</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_8</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_Notify_Join" name="Notifications sent">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_7</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_8</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_9</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_GatherCompanyInfo" name="Gather information from companies">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_9</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_10</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_EndOfPeriod" name="End of leave period">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_10</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_11</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:timerEventDefinition id="TimerDef_EndOfPeriod"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_DecideExtension" name="Decide about extension">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_11</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_12</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Extension" name="Extension requested?" default="Flow_ExtensionNo">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_12</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ExtensionYes</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ExtensionNo</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_LeaveCompleted" name="Leave completed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ExtensionNo</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_Planning" targetRef="Task_FetchModels"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_2" sourceRef="Task_FetchModels" targetRef="Task_SelectModel"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_3" sourceRef="Task_SelectModel" targetRef="Task_CollectInfo"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_4" sourceRef="Task_CollectInfo" targetRef="Gateway_Notify_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_5" sourceRef="Gateway_Notify_Split" targetRef="Task_NotifySocialSecurity"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_6" sourceRef="Gateway_Notify_Split" targetRef="Task_NotifyCompany"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_7" sourceRef="Task_NotifySocialSecurity" targetRef="Gateway_Notify_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_8" sourceRef="Task_NotifyCompany" targetRef="Gateway_Notify_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_9" sourceRef="Gateway_Notify_Join" targetRef="Task_GatherCompanyInfo"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" sourceRef="Task_GatherCompanyInfo" targetRef="Event_EndOfPeriod"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11" sourceRef="Event_EndOfPeriod" targetRef="Task_DecideExtension"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_12" sourceRef="Task_DecideExtension" targetRef="Gateway_Extension"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ExtensionYes" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_Extension" targetRef="Task_FetchModels">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${extensionRequested == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ExtensionNo" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_Extension" targetRef="EndEvent_LeaveCompleted"/>
  </bpmn:process>
  <bpmn:process id="Process_Unused" isExecutable="false"/>
</bpmn:definitions>
